summary: Iteration 47: Cart Booster Bug Fixes Verified - All 4 bugs fixed and working. BoosterBar shows slabs from /api/booster/config with correct field names (is_enabled, min_cart_value). Upsell endpoint works without auth. 'You May Also Like' shows in CartPage and CartDrawer. UpsellModal opens with 8 products.
critical_code_review_comments: BoosterBar.jsx correctly fetches from /api/booster/config and uses is_enabled/min_cart_value fields
CartPage.jsx correctly fetches slabs and upsell suggestions
cart_routes.py upsell-suggestions endpoint correctly handles optional auth (works for guests)
booster_routes.py /config endpoint returns both slabs and messages in single response
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cart booster features fully functional. Slabs: ₹1500→₹100 OFF, ₹2500→₹200 OFF, ₹3500→₹300 OFF, ₹5999→5% OFF, ₹9999→5% OFF. All enabled. Upsell returns 8 products without auth. BoosterBar renders at top of viewport as sticky bar. UpsellModal opens when clicking 'Add more to unlock' button.
